common.helpText: Hotline {phone} — AI Call Center answers day and night.
common.disclaimer: The result is advisory. A Committee specialist makes the final decision.

sertifikat.name: AI Certificate
sertifikat.card: Answers certificate questions 24/7 and shows the documents and links you need.
sertifikat.lead: Type your certificate question. The system finds the answer in laws and regulations and shows the list of required documents and links.

fields.label: Your question
fields.value: What certificate do I need to export dried apricots to Turkey?

fields.label: Document type
options: Not sure — let the system decide

paragraphs: To export dried apricots to Turkey you need a phytosanitary certificate. It is issued by the Committee's regional quarantine inspectorate.
Required documents: export contract, invoice, laboratory report (aflatoxin and pesticide residues), details of the loading site.
Where to apply: applications go through the E-Fito system. The result is sent to the Turkish side electronically in ePhyto format.

blocks.title: Processing time: 1 working day
blocks.text: With a complete set of documents, the certificate is issued within one working day.

blocks.title: Please note
blocks.text: From 2026 Turkey tightened the sulphur (SO₂) limit for dried fruit. The laboratory report must include this indicator.

steps.title: You write a question
steps.text: In plain language, as if writing to a specialist.

steps.title: The system finds the answer
steps.text: It pulls the relevant part of the law, regulation or Committee rules.

steps.title: Answer and links
steps.text: A short answer, a list of documents and a link to the official source.

sertifikat.forWho: Exporters, importers and producers. A quick reference for inspectors too.
sertifikat.basis: Quarantine, veterinary and sanitary legislation, technical regulations, Committee orders.

call-center.name: AI Call Center
call-center.card: Answers calls to the 1288 hotline instantly and connects complex questions to a specialist.
call-center.lead: When you call the 1288 hotline, AI answers first. Simple questions get an instant answer; complex ones are passed to a specialist.

lines.text: Hello. The milk I bought at a shop is past its expiry date. Where do I report it?
Hello. Your report has been received. Please give the shop's name and address. Keep the receipt — an inspector will contact you within 1 working day.
Thank you. Report number: 1288-048213. I've sent you an SMS. It has been routed to the Tashkent city sanitary supervision department.

blocks.title: Transfer to a specialist
blocks.text: If the citizen asks, or the question is complex, the call moves to a live operator, who receives the conversation transcript ready to go.

steps.title: The call is received
steps.text: At 1288, any time, in any language.

steps.title: Speech becomes text
steps.text: The system understands the question and identifies the topic and region.

steps.title: Answer or transfer
steps.text: Simple questions are answered at once. Complex ones go to a specialist.

call-center.forWho: Citizens and businesses. For Committee operators, it takes routine calls off their hands.
call-center.basis: Regulation on the hotline, the law on appeals.

murojaatlar.name: AI Appeals
murojaatlar.card: Reads each appeal, identifies its type and sends it to the right department.
murojaatlar.lead: The system reads appeals that arrive via Telegram, the website, 1288 and mail. It identifies the type, region and priority and routes them to the responsible department.

fields.label: Appeal text
fields.value: Five children were poisoned by food served at kindergarten No. 14 in Samarkand. Please carry out an inspection.

blocks.title: Owner: Samarkand city sanitary supervision
blocks.text: Response deadline: 1 day. Children's health is the top priority. Management has also been notified.

blocks.title: Similar appeals: 2 (within 7 days)
blocks.text: Complaints about this kindergarten also came in on 18.10 and 21.10. The system linked them into one case.

blocks.title: Reply sent to the citizen
blocks.text: "Your appeal has been received, number 2026-10-23-0912. An inspector will contact you within 1 day."

blocks.title: Linked with AI Kitchen
blocks.text: The last 3 days of footage from kindergarten No. 14's kitchen camera have been prepared for the inspector.

steps.title: The appeal arrives
steps.text: From any channel: bot, website, phone, mail.

steps.title: The system reads and classifies it
steps.text: Type, region, site and priority are identified automatically.

steps.title: Routed to the right owner
steps.text: To the right department, with a deadline. The citizen gets a reply letter.

murojaatlar.forWho: The Committee's office and regional departments. For citizens, a faster answer.
murojaatlar.basis: Law on appeals of individuals and legal entities, Committee record-keeping rules.

fermer.name: AI Farmer
fermer.card: Predicts when pests will multiply. The warning goes straight to the farmer's phone.
fermer.lead: The system predicts in advance when pests will multiply in your field. Pheromone trap and weather data are analysed. Warnings arrive via Telegram.

blocks.title: Cotton bollworm — high risk
blocks.text: An outbreak is expected within 5–7 days. 48 moths in the trap over 3 days (threshold: 20). Inspect the field.

blocks.title: Spider mite — medium risk
blocks.text: Hot, dry weather favours it. Check the undersides of leaves.

blocks.title: Aphids — low risk
blocks.text: No risk for now. Next check in 5 days.

blocks.title: Recommendation
blocks.text: Start treatment within 3 days. For the right product, consult your district agronomist or a Quarantine Institute specialist: 1288.

steps.title: Pick a field and crop
steps.text: The farmer registers once. After that the system keeps watch.

steps.title: Traps and weather are analysed
steps.text: More than 30,000 pheromone traps and Uzhydromet data.

steps.title: A warning arrives
steps.text: By Telegram or SMS, in plain language, with what to do.

fermer.forWho: Farms and smallholders, cluster agronomists, regional quarantine inspectors.
fermer.basis: Data from the forecasting laboratory of the Plant Quarantine and Protection Research Institute.

reyting.name: AI Rating
reyting.card: Gives each of 80,000 sites a risk score. Inspectors go to the riskiest first.
reyting.lead: The system gives each of 80,000 supervised sites a risk score. Inspectors don't go everywhere — they go where the risk is highest. Honest businesses are inspected less.

blocks.title: "Baraka savdo" LLC — Chilanzar district
blocks.meta: Last inspection: 14.06.2026 · Complaints: 2 (90 days) · Registered since 2019

blocks.title: Documents complete (−10 points)
blocks.text: Sanitary certificate and staff medical checks are within their validity period.

steps.title: Data is collected
steps.text: Past inspections, complaints, product type, region.

steps.title: The system computes a score
steps.text: Each site gets a score from 0 to 100, updated daily.

steps.title: Inspectors are directed
steps.text: Plans start from the riskiest sites, with the reason shown.

reyting.forWho: Committee inspectors and regional offices. Businesses see their own score in their account.
reyting.basis: Procedure for assessing the risk level of supervised sites, Single Window and supervision registry data.

import.name: AI Import
import.card: Gives every shipment at the border a colour: green, yellow or red. Safe cargo clears fast.
import.lead: For every shipment arriving at the border, the system assesses the risk in advance and gives it one colour: green — clears, yellow — document check, red — laboratory.

blocks.title: Documents will be checked. No laboratory sample needed.
blocks.text: Estimated time: 2 hours. Shipment: 20 t of bananas via Kazakhstan, exporter Fresh Fruits LLP.

blocks.title: Exporter history: 1 non-conformity (12 months)
blocks.text: In March 2026 the certificate number did not match. Hence the document check.

blocks.title: No international alerts
blocks.text: No signals for bananas in RASFF or INFOSAN in the last 30 days.

blocks.title: Phytosanitary certificate confirmed
blocks.text: The ePhyto number was found in the exporting country's system and matches.

blocks.title: Inspector's decision
blocks.text: The colour is a recommendation. The border inspector makes the final decision and records it in the system.

steps.title: Shipment data arrives
steps.text: Pulled automatically from E-Fito and the customs declaration.

steps.title: The system assesses risk
steps.text: Exporter history, product type, country, international alerts.

steps.title: One colour
steps.text: Green, yellow or red. The inspector sees why and decides.

import.forWho: Border quarantine and veterinary inspectors. Importers see their shipment status in their account.
import.basis: Quarantine control procedure, data-exchange agreement with customs, international alert systems.

eksport.name: AI Export
eksport.card: Checks in advance whether a product meets foreign requirements and shows the risk of rejection.
eksport.lead: Check whether your product meets the destination country's requirements before you ship. The system shows the gaps and estimates the risk of rejection.

blocks.title: Phytosanitary certificate (ePhyto) — ready
blocks.text: Electronic exchange with the EU system (TRACES) is working.

blocks.title: Pesticide residue (MRL) — within limits
blocks.text: Laboratory report of 02.10.2026; all indicators below EU limits.

blocks.title: Aflatoxin test — older than 6 months
blocks.text: The EU requires a test less than 3 months old. Submit a new sample to the laboratory.

blocks.title: Labelling — does not meet EU requirements
blocks.text: The label lacks ingredients and allergens in English. Check and fix it with AI Label.

blocks.title: Past experience
blocks.text: In 2025–2026 there were 25 EU alerts on dried fruit from Uzbekistan, mainly for aflatoxin. That is why this test matters.

steps.title: Pick a country and product
steps.text: The system loads that country's current requirements.

steps.title: Documents and tests are compared
steps.text: Certificate, laboratory, labelling — each checked separately.

steps.title: A list of gaps
steps.text: What is missing and where it can be fixed.

eksport.forWho: Exporters, clusters and agribusinesses. Also for regional quarantine inspectors.
eksport.basis: Importing countries' requirements (EU, China, Russia), ISPM standards, Codex norms.

bozor.name: AI Market
bozor.card: Monitors the market and international alerts, and signals when a dangerous product must be recalled.
bozor.lead: The system monitors international alert systems (RASFF, INFOSAN) and local market monitoring. It singles out risks for the Uzbek market and issues a recall signal.

blocks.title: RASFF 2026.4312 — melamine in milk powder
blocks.text: Source: Poland, 19.10.2026. Two shipments from this producer entered Uzbekistan (AI Traceability). A recall is recommended.

blocks.title: Local monitoring — expired dairy product
blocks.text: Found in 4 shops in Tashkent on 21.10.2026. Inspectors have been assigned.

blocks.title: Social media — no serious signals
blocks.text: 3 complaints about the brand in the last 30 days, all about taste, not safety.

blocks.title: How a recall works
blocks.text: The signal uses AI Traceability to find the batch, lists the shops and sends it to the regional inspector.

steps.title: Sources are monitored
steps.text: International systems, local monitoring, laboratory, social media.

steps.title: The system filters what matters
steps.text: Only products and producers that reached the Uzbek market.

steps.title: A signal is sent
steps.text: A recall recommendation goes to inspectors and management the same day.

bozor.forWho: The Committee's market supervision department, regional inspectors, importers.
bozor.basis: RASFF and INFOSAN systems, procedure for withdrawing food products from the market.

yorliq.name: AI Label
yorliq.card: Checks a product label from a photo: ingredients, dates and banned additives.
yorliq.lead: Take a photo of a product label. The system checks ingredients, shelf life, E-numbers and mandatory marks against the requirements and shows the result in a minute.

fields.label: Label photo (JPG or PNG, up to 50 MB)
fields.hint: Drop a photo here or choose a file

blocks.title: No label in the state language
blocks.text: Ingredients and storage conditions are only in a foreign language. Requirement: Uzbek is mandatory.

blocks.title: Banned additive: E-171
blocks.text: Listed in the ingredients. The recipe must change before registration.

blocks.title: Shelf life and producer — correct
blocks.text: Date, batch number and address were read and meet the requirements.

steps.title: A photo is uploaded
steps.text: Choose a label photo from your phone or computer.

steps.title: The system reads it
steps.text: The text is extracted and compared with the list of requirements.

steps.title: Result and advice
steps.text: Non-conformities are shown with how to fix them.

yorliq.forWho: Producers, importers and Committee inspectors — a first check before registration.
yorliq.basis: Sanitary rules and technical regulations on food labelling.

hisobot.name: AI Report
hisobot.card: A dashboard for management: key indicators on one screen, an answer to any question in a minute.
hisobot.lead: A dashboard for management. Data from every system on one screen. Ask in plain language — get the answer in a minute.

fields.label: Question (optional)
fields.value: Which region has the most non-conformities?

blocks.title: Answer: "Which region has the most non-conformities?"
blocks.text: Fergana — 61 (last 30 days), then Tashkent city — 54, Samarkand — 39. In Fergana the main cause is labelling (24).

steps.title: Data is collected
steps.text: Supervision, appeals, laboratory, border — from every system, daily.

steps.title: The system calculates
steps.text: Indicators, changes and causes — automatically.

steps.title: Managers look and ask
steps.text: One screen. Questions in plain language; answers with a number and a source.

hisobot.forWho: Committee leadership, heads of regional offices, the analytics department.
hisobot.basis: The Committee's single database, the unified platform under PQ-178.

kuzatuv.name: AI Traceability
kuzatuv.card: Shows where each batch came from and where it went. If a problem arises, the source is found in a minute.
kuzatuv.lead: Every batch is recorded with a QR code from field to shop. If a problem arises, the system finds the source and where the product went in a minute.

steps.title: Field — Fergana, Kuva district
steps.text: "Oltin bog'" farm · 12.09.2026 · AI Farmer: pest risk was low.

steps.title: Laboratory — Tashkent central lab
steps.text: 15.09.2026 · Pesticide residue within limits · No pathogens detected.

steps.title: Warehouse — "Agro-log", Tashkent
steps.text: 17.09.2026 · Temperature regime not breached (sensor).

steps.title: Market — 14 shops, 3 regions
steps.text: 20.09.2026 · Tashkent (9), Samarkand (3), Jizzakh (2). Remaining: 0.6 t.

blocks.title: If a problem arises
blocks.text: One button sends a recall signal to all 14 shops. The source — the farm and the lab result — is visible immediately.

steps.title: Recorded by QR
steps.text: The batch is scanned at every stage: field, lab, warehouse, shop.

steps.title: The system links the chain
steps.text: E-Fito, laboratory and retail systems are combined into one history.

steps.title: Source in a minute
steps.text: When a complaint or alert comes in — where it came from and where it is sold.

kuzatuv.forWho: Inspectors, warehouses and retail chains, producers. Citizens see a product's path via QR.
kuzatuv.basis: The unified platform and traceability registry under PQ-178, the E-Fito system.

oshxona.name: AI Kitchen
oshxona.card: Monitors kindergarten and school kitchens through cameras and reports hygiene violations at once.
oshxona.lead: Cameras in kindergarten and school kitchens connect to the system. AI watches hygiene rules: head covering, gloves, raw and cooked food kept apart. When a rule is broken, the person in charge is notified immediately.

items.label: Green · live
items.title: Kindergarten No. 112, Yunusabad
items.text: All staff wear head coverings and gloves. No violations in the last 24 hours.

items.label: Yellow · live
items.title: School No. 45, Chilanzar
items.text: 10:42 — a staff member worked without gloves. The manager was notified; fixed at 10:51.

items.label: Red · live
items.title: Kindergarten No. 7, Sergeli
items.text: 09:15 — raw meat and cooked food on the same table. An inspector was called.

items.label: Green · live
items.title: School No. 23, Mirzo Ulugbek
items.text: Fridge temperature within limits per sensor (+3°C).

blocks.title: Children's privacy
blocks.text: Cameras cover only the kitchen area. Children are not filmed. Footage is kept for 30 days and only inspectors can view it.

blocks.title: Why it matters
blocks.text: In 2025, 1,940 children were poisoned by food in educational institutions. The system flags violations before anyone gets sick.

steps.title: A camera is connected
steps.text: Existing cameras connect to the system; no new equipment is needed.

steps.title: The system watches the rules
steps.text: Head covering, gloves, raw and cooked food, cleanliness — automatically.

steps.title: Violation — instant alert
steps.text: To the kitchen manager and the regional inspector. Serious cases go to the head.

oshxona.forWho: Sanitary and epidemiological service, school and kindergarten heads, local administrations.
oshxona.basis: Sanitary rules for catering in educational institutions, the law on personal data.
